title: Alien
speaker: Daniel Whiteson
speaker_line: an experimental particle physicist at UC Irvine and a researcher at CERN. Dedicated to making complex physics accessible and entertaining, he is the co-author of We Have No Idea (with Jorge Cham) and Do Aliens Speak Physics? (with Andy Warner). He regularly explores the deepest mysteries of the cosmos on his podcast, Daniel and Kelly's Extraordinary Universe.
question: If we met an alien intelligence, would we even recognise it?
